section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the importance of positive body image, specifically body appreciation, and highlights racial differences in body image, noting that Black women tend to report less body dissatisfaction than White women. The current study aims to examine body appreciation and its association with ethnic identity in Black college women, utilizing the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS). The section emphasizes the need for further research on the BAS in diverse populations and its correlates in Black women.
